  \begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\footnotesize\raggedright
  \texttt{D1\_csi}. Nondeterministic. extract\_lineage\_at\_commit seeds the graph from a Python set, so node insertion order follows PYTHONHASHSEED, and Louvain is order-sensitive. Across eight node orderings of one fixed 223-node graph the value took four distinct values spanning 0.714 to 0.929, a swing of 0.214 against a corpus SD of 0.123. \texttt{D1\_n\_comm}. Nondeterministic, same cause. The same fixed graph yielded 9 or 10 communities depending on node insertion order.
  \end{minipage}
